meta.title: Laandet – rent, lend and give away locally in Steigen
meta.description: Laandet is a local meeting place in Steigen where you can rent out, lend, ask for and give away things.

common.draftBanner: Draft – not legally reviewed. The text may change before launch.
common.translationBanner: Informational translation. The Norwegian version is the binding one.

footer.tagline: More use. Less buying. A little closer to each other.
footer.localStart: Made for the local community in Steigen.
footer.rankingText: Listings are shown newest first. Nobody can pay to appear higher up.
footer.pilotNote: Laandet is in a pilot phase. Example listings are marked «Example».

home.lead: What you need may be right nearby. Rent, lend and give away locally – and let your things be useful.
home.heroAlt: Illustration of a fjord and boathouse in Nordland
home.emptyRent: No listings yet. Be the first to post something!
home.examplesNote: Listings marked «Example» are fictional and cannot be rented.
home.howStep1: Find something nearby, or post what you need.
home.howStep2: Get in touch and agree on the practical details.
home.howStep3: Collect it, have it delivered or meet at an agreed place.
home.howStep4: Return it in the same condition – or give it away for good.
home.rentalsSoon: Requests, rental agreements and condition reports open soon. You can already post listings.

wizard.lead: It doesn't have to be new. Just useful for someone nearby.
wizard.stepType: What do you want to do?
wizard.freeOnlyNotice: In this category, things can for now only be lent for free or given away.
wizard.titleHint: Short and specific, e.g. «Pressure washer with patio cleaner». No phone numbers or links.
wizard.descriptionHint: What is it, what is it good for, and what should the borrower know?
wizard.knownDefectsHint: List every fault you know of. Write «No known faults» if there are none.
wizard.photosHint: Up to 8 photos of the actual item. We remove location and other information from the photos.
wizard.declaredValueHint: Roughly what it costs to buy a similar item. Used in the rental agreement. Items above 5 000 kr cannot be rented out yet.
wizard.depositHint: Optional. Cannot be higher than the value. Paid directly between you.
wizard.usageHint: E.g. «Not for salt water» or «Max 750 kg load».
wizard.areaNoteHint: E.g. «near the school». Never your home address.
wizard.handoverLabel: How can the item be handed over?
wizard.handoverWantedLabel: How would you like to get it?
wizard.deliveryOption: Can be delivered by the owner
wizard.restrictedAckLabel: I have read the safety information for this category, and the item is in safe working order.
wizard.previewNoAddress: Check that you have not written your home address, phone number or email.
wizard.warnContact: The description seems to contain contact details. It is better to share contact details in messages once you have agreed.
wizard.typeLocked: The type cannot be changed after the listing has been created.
wizard.warnKeywords: This listing may concern a prohibited or restricted item. Please check the rules. If you publish, a moderator will review it.

pages.howLead: A good deal starts with someone nearby.
pages.howRent1: Find something nearby with search and filters. You see the approximate area, price, deposit and how the item can be collected or delivered.
pages.howRent2: Soon you can send a request. The owner decides whether to accept it.
pages.howRent3: When you agree, Laandet creates a simple rental agreement that both accept. Payment happens directly between you.
pages.howRent4: At handover and return you record the condition with photos, so you both have the same documentation.
pages.howWanted1: Post a wanted listing, e.g. «Want to rent a trailer in Nordfold this weekend». Others can reply with their own listings.
pages.howGive1: Give away things you no longer need – free and for good. You choose who gets the item, and describe known faults honestly.
pages.howStatus: You can create an account, post all three types of listings and search. Requests, messages, rental agreements and condition reports open in the next step of the pilot.
pages.safetyLead: Safety is part of Laandet from the start. Here is what applies today – and what is planned.
pages.safetyNow1: Everyone who posts listings has confirmed their email address.
pages.safetyNow2: We only show approximate areas. Location and other information are removed from photos.
pages.safetyNow3: Every listing can be reported. Moderators give reasons for decisions, and you can appeal.
pages.safetyNow4: Prohibited and dangerous items are not allowed. Some categories need extra care.
pages.safetyNow5: Laandet does not handle money and never sends payment links.
pages.safetyPlanned1: Rental agreements, condition reports and a clear process when something goes wrong – coming in the next step of the pilot.
pages.safetyPlanned2: BankID verification and renting out items above 5 000 kr – later, when it is safe and legally clarified.
pages.safetyPlanned3: Laandet has no insurance for users. Check what your own insurance covers.
pages.aboutText1: Laandet is a local meeting place where things that already exist can be useful to more people. A trailer for moving, a carpet cleaner for the sofa or two kayaks when friends come to visit.
pages.aboutText2: We start in Steigen and build the service together with the people who use it. Laandet is an independent project in the G-PSI.ai portfolio.
pages.aboutText3: Laandet is a meeting place, not a rental company, a bank or an insurer. Agreements are made between users.
pages.contactLead: Questions, feedback or something to report?
pages.contactMissing: Contact details will be published before launch.
pages.transparencyLead: What it costs to run Laandet, and the voluntary support we have received.
pages.transparencyEmpty: We will publish figures once the first invoices and any contributions are recorded. We only show figures we have checked.
